interface.signature: def getMaxRepetitions(s1: str, n1: int, s2: str, n2: int) -> int

preconditions.expression: isinstance(s1, str) and isinstance(s2, str) and len(s1) > 0 and len(s2) > 0
preconditions.description: s1 and s2 are non-empty strings.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(n1, int) and isinstance(n2, int) and 0 <= n1 <= 10**6 and 1 <= n2 <= 10**6
preconditions.description: n1 and n2 are integers within the specified bounds.
The length of s1 and s2 is at most 100 characters.

postconditions.description: The returned value M is a non-negative integer.
The string formed by repeating s2, n2 times, and then repeating that result return_value times, is a subsequence of the string formed by repeating s1, n1 times.

The string formed by repeating s2, n2 times, and then repeating that result (return_value + 1) times, is NOT a subsequence of the string formed by repeating s1, n1 times, ensuring return_value is the maximum such integer.

helpers.is_subsequence: def is_subsequence(s1: str, s2: str) -> bool: i, j = 0, 0; while i < len(s1) and j < len(s2): if s1[i] == s2[j]: j += 1; i += 1; return j == len(s2)
